question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Lack of feeling
solution:
The correct answer is '**Apathy**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the given words and their meaning.
 
• **Empathy:** the ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
 
• **Apathy: **lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
 
• **Telepathy: **the supposed communication of thoughts or ideas by means other than known senses.
 
• **Sympathy: **feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune.

Hence, the correct one-word substitution is **apathy.**

 
• **Example: ***The **apathy **__of the management lead to a mass resignation campaign by the employees*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• शब्दों का अर्थ
 
• Empathy: समानुभूति
 
• Apathy: उदासीनता
 
• Telepathy: मानसिक दूरसंचार
 
• Sympathy: सहानुभूति

इसलिए सही शब्द **उदासीनता **है

 
• **Example**: *The landlord showed **apathy **__to the plight of his workers*.
